episodes.title: Angel Attack
episodes.summary: In the year 2015, an Angel returns to attack Tokyo-3. Misato Katsuragi transports Shinji to the NERV base overseen by his estranged father, Gendo.

episodes.title: The Beast
episodes.summary: After piloting the Eva Unit 01, Shinji wakes up in the hospital with no memory of the battle. Feeling sorry for him, Misato lets him move in with her.

episodes.title: A Transfer
episodes.summary: Word gets around school that Shinji is the Eva pilot; his classmate Toji resents him for it. An Angel appears and Shinji must pilot in combat again.

episodes.title: Hedgehog's Dilemma
episodes.summary: Stressed out following his last battle, Shinji runs away from home and meets Kensuke. After NERV brings him back in, Misato offers him a choice.

episodes.title: Rei I
episodes.summary: Unit 00's pilot Rei Ayanami appears to have recovered, but she has no friends, no records of her past, and no interest in getting to know Shinji.

episodes.title: Rei II
episodes.summary: As the Fifth Angel drills toward NERV, Misato leads Operation Yashima: All of Japan's power will be diverted to take out Ramiel with a positron rifle.

episodes.title: A Human Work
episodes.summary: Ritsuko tells Shinji about the classified true cause of the Second Impact. Then she and Misato attend the field test for an Eva competitor mecha.

episodes.title: Asuka Strikes!
episodes.summary: Shinji and his friends accompany Misato to meet Eva Unit 02 and its pilot Asuka at sea. Misato's old friend Ryoji Kaji is aboard with his own agenda.

episodes.title: Both of You, Dance Like You Want to Win!
episodes.summary: Asuka and Shinji face another Angel but it gets the upper hand. They now have six days to learn synchronized moves to destroy it completely.

episodes.title: Magma Diver
episodes.summary: NERV learns of an Angel in dormant embryonic form inside a volcano. Using equipment designed for magma, Asuka is sent to retrieve it with Unit 02.

episodes.title: The Day Tokyo-3 Stood Still
episodes.summary: Tokyo-3 loses power just as another Angel is detected. The Eva pilots must enter the base from the surface while NERV preps the Units manually.

episodes.title: She said, "Don't Make Others Suffer for Your Personal Hatred"
episodes.summary: With Gendo and Fuyutsuki in Antarctica, a newly promoted Misato is in charge when a new Angel appears above the Earth, aiming to bomb Tokyo-3.

episodes.title: Lilliputian Hitcher
episodes.summary: An Angel infiltrates NERV, quickly taking over the MAGI supercomputer. Ritsuko proposes writing a program to forcibly evolve Ireul to its extinction.

episodes.title: Weaving a Story
episodes.summary: As Seele reviews NERV and Gendo's actions with the Third through Eleventh Angels, Ritsuko conducts a test in which the Eva pilots switch Units.

episodes.title: Those Women Longed for the Touch of Others' Lips, and Thus Invited Their Kisses
episodes.summary: For the first time in years, Shinji meets his father at his mother's grave. Ritsuko, Misato and Ryoji attend a wedding and Asuka goes on a date.

episodes.title: Splitting of the Breast
episodes.summary: While in battle, Shinji and Unit 01 are engulfed in the spreading shadow of an Angel. As NERV fears them both lost, Shinji has a strange experience.

episodes.title: Fourth Children
episodes.summary: NERV-02 in Nevada vanishes, along with the Eva Unit 04. With Unit 03 on the way, Gendo orders Ritsuko to assign a pilot to it.

episodes.title: Ambivalence
episodes.summary: Unit 03 arrives from the United States, but Shinji still doesn't know who its pilot is. During testing, NERV learns Unit 03 is possessed by an Angel.

episodes.title: Introjection
episodes.summary: Distraught after the battle, Shinji vows to never pilot an Eva again and quits NERV once more. Just as he's about to leave, another Angel attacks.

episodes.title: Weaving a Story II: Oral Stage
episodes.summary: After achieving an unheard of synchronization rate, Shinji merges with Unit 01. While he has an out of body experience, NERV works to salvage him.

episodes.title: He Was Aware That He Was Still a Child
episodes.summary: Seele kidnaps Fuyutsuki and interrogates him about NERV and Gendo's true intentions, revealing events from the past. Ryoji goes missing.

episodes.title: Don't Be
episodes.summary: Asuka's synchronization ratio continues to drop, undermining her self-confidence. Determined to show her worth, she ignores orders during battle.

episodes.title: Rei III
episodes.summary: Despite her struggles, Asuka is ordered to assist Rei in battle against Armisael. When she fails, Rei makes a desperate move in order to save Shinji.

episodes.title: The Beginning and the End, or "Knockin' on Heaven's Door"
episodes.summary: Kaworu Nagisa, the Fifth Child, comes to NERV to pilot Unit 02 in Asuka's place. He's friendly to Shinji, but he's shrouded in mystery.

episodes.title: Do You Love Me?
episodes.summary: The Human Instrumentality Project begins, and the souls of humanity merge. The Eva pilots confront the nature of their existence as reality dissolves.

episodes.title: Take Care of Yourself
episodes.summary: The Human Instrumentality Project continues. Shinji must decide whether to accept a world alone, or embrace connections with others.
